subject: Post-call: Hosted API usage forecast, pricing bands & peak concurrency
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@circuitai.com>, Nina Patel <nina@circuitai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: hosted API usage shape + pricing targets

Hi Liam / Nina — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and ask so we’re aligned heading into the pricing proposal: 

1) Consumption shape (you confirmed on the call):
- Expected steady-state monthly tokens: 18M–35M (you said current prod run-rate is ~22M/mo).
- Target signed baseline for first 12 months: ~25M/mo (you’re comfortable committing to a 12–month band once we align on pricing).
- Token mix: ~65% prompt / 35% completion on average; some flows (summarization) have higher completion ratio.

2) Concurrency & peak profile:
- Typical 5–95th percentile TPS during normal PV: 40–95 TPS.
- 99th percentile burst windows observed on call: ~220 TPS (we flagged concern about brief spikes during feature rollouts).
- You mentioned product launches could produce sub-minute spikes — you estimated up to ~400 TPS for ~30–45s during major releases (please confirm below).

3) Unit economics target:
- CircuitAI indicated target pricing in the ballpark of $12–$18 / 1M tokens for hosted (goal is to hit $15 / 1M as an aspirational target).
- You’re also evaluating Reserved vs Hosted with burst options — noted.

Next steps I’ll take:
- Attach the traffic sample you promised (circuitai_traffic_sample.csv) and can incorporate it into our internal SLA/throughput model.
- Karthik / Marissa: will you draft 2 pricing options (hosted slab + reserved bump) we can review with CircuitAI?
- Liam / Nina: confirm the 400 TPS short-launch spike estimate and any other high-impact traffic windows (timezones/dates).

Attachments: circuitai_traffic_sample.csv (traffic sample CSV)

Thanks — tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0183
https://redwoodinference.com

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@circuitai.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nina Patel <nina@circuitai.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Dec 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: hosted API usage shape + pricing targets

Thanks Tessa — great summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Baseline: confirmed ~22M/mo now; given roadmap we’d expect 25M–30M within Q1 after the new model goes live. Long-term (12m) possible upside to ~40M if adoption scales as forecast.
- Spikes: the 220 TPS number is our 99th percentile during normal marketing pushes. For the planned product launch (see attached launch plan), we do anticipate very short spikes up to 400 TPS for up to 60 seconds, but that happens perhaps 2–3x during the 48-hour launch window.
- SLA concern: we’d need clarity on how Redwood handles >99th percentile bursts (fallback model variants? queueing?) and whether burst minutes are billed differently.

Attached: circuitai_launch_plan.pdf (high-level launch timeline)

Questions for you now: can you share an indicative hosted slab pricing (range) and the burst policy so we can align with procurement? Also curious about any recommended throttling strategy on our side to smooth spike billing.

— Liam

Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap: hosted API usage shape + pricing targets

Tessa / Marissa — forwarding Liam’s clarifications. Drafted two pragmatic bands we can offer as an initial proposal: 

Option A (Hosted slabs — simple, no commit):
- 0–10M tokens / month: $22 / 1M tokens
- 10–50M tokens / month: $17 / 1M tokens
- 50M+ tokens / month: $13 / 1M tokens
- Burst handling: short spikes (<= 60s) within 2x of 99th percentile are accommodated automatically; beyond that we propose a soft throttle after 60s or a paid burst add-on.

Option B (12-month Reserved band — preferred economics):
- 25M committed baseline: $14 / 1M tokens on committed usage, $18 / 1M on overage (hosted slab pricing)
- Optional burst buffer: add-on pool of 500k tokens / month for launch windows at $10 / 1M equivalent (billed monthly).

Rationale: CircuitAI’s stated ARR upside and short high-frequency spikes make Option B attractive for predictable unit econ. If they expect to hit 40M+ in 12m, we should discuss graduated reserved tiers to get to $12 / 1M.

Next for us: I’ll assemble a short PDF summary (redwood_pricing_slabs_v1.pdf) and a simple cost delta sheet showing monthly $ spend under each option for their sample traffic. Tessa — do you want me to include a recommended throttling policy we can hand to their engineering team?

— Karthik

1) Karthik & I will send a concise proposal by EOD Friday with:
   - Hosted slab quote and the 12-month reserved band (Option A + B summarized).
   - Explicit burst policy language (how short spikes are handled, billing for sustained bursts >60s).
2) Please share any historical telemetry windows (UTC timestamps) for prior launches if available — that will let us model queueing/burst cost precisely.
3) Proposed follow-up: 30-min technical sync with your infra lead (preferably next week) so we can align throttles, caching recommendations, and suggested client-side smoothing (rate limiter guidance).

I’ll attach the pricing summary (redwood_pricing_slabs_v1.pdf) in the proposal email. If CircuitAI is comfortable with the reserved band economics, we’ll draft a simple mutual action plan and term sheet to get procurement moving.

Thanks — talk soon.
